text:
Omar H.: Kickoff for Solstice Systems joint bench. Goal: measure end-to-end perf/W, steady-state throughput (goal ~1800-2200 toks/s), and isolate kernel-level hotpaths. Need a minimal on-site checklist and who takes what. Run window proposed Thu 09:00 PT.
Jin Park: I'll take telemetry. Prefer to stream token-level timing + PDU power every 1s. Which models/datasets?
Omar H.: Standardize on redwood-mini-suite v3 and open-llama-7B-q4f for cross-arch parity. Use redwood-microbench v3 for input corpus. Disable KV caching and fixed-seed workloads. Batch sizes: 1,4,16,64.
Lena Ortiz: For kernel changes: provide them as dynamic modules the partner can drop into `/opt/solstice/modules` so no full kernel rebuild. We'll attach a compatibility matrix and a signed risk assessment doc. Also request partner run with seccomp profile.
Evan G: Communications note: Solstice expects a joint blog and a datasheet. Recommend a 72-hour internal validation window post-run before public comms. Also check partner NDA clause for embargo windows.
Jin Park: Telemetry plan: JSON lines push to our `telemetry-ingest` with fields: ts, sample_id, model, tokens, latency_ms, cpu_mW, gpu_W, pdu_watts, kernel_event. Will post schema draft to #eng-ml and link to runbook.
BenchBot: Lab reservation confirmed: solstice-bench-2 booked Thu 09:00-13:00 PT. Use `@BenchBot extend solstice-bench-2 2h` to add time.
Omar H.: Action log: Jin -> telemetry schema + sample payload; Lena -> module package + compatibility matrix + seccomp profile; Evan -> co-blog draft + embargo check; Omar -> canonical run scripts and bench automation. Proposed standardized run command:
```
./bench_driver --suite redwood-mini-suite-v3 \
  --models open-llama-7b-q4f,redwood-mpt-7b-q4 \
  --seq 2048 --batches 1,4,16,64 \
  --measure throughput,power,latency,perf_per_watt \
  --trace kernel:hotpaths --out traces/solstice_day1
```
Lena Ortiz: Add a hard stop: if perf/W regresses >7% vs our baseline (baseline tag: baseline/solstice-ref) abort and capture full traces.
Jin Park: Will push telemetry PR with schema + example payload by Mon EOD and include a small ingestion CLI for partner to test.
Evan G: I'll reach out to Solstice comms tomorrow and share the draft co-blog template. @Lena @Jin drop suggested quotes in the doc so legal can pre-approve.
Omar H.: Let's aim to close all PRs by Wed EOD and do a dry-run Wed 15:00 PT. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
